* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Character: Lieutenant Greeve, Endor, R
|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/lieutenantgreeve.html</ref>

This Rebel sharpshooter must have been born with a rifle in his hand. When using any weapon, not only is he +1 to weapon destiny, but if he makes it the target suffers not only the weapon hit effects, but is forfeit - 3 also. If that character is forfeit 3 or less, that's as good as a forfeit = 0 weapon, normally the realm of main characters only!

Hand him an [[A280 Sharpshooter Rifle]] and he gets even nastier. In the ideal circumstance, Greeve and his A280 are safely tucked away alone at an adjacent site to where the battle broke out. You have a pile of force. Thus you may fire repeatedly first shot free, subsequent shots at 2 Force, At the same target at +3 to your weapon destiny draw, and the hit characters are forfeit - 3. If you are drawing a few EPP enhanced battle destinies in that battle, the battle damage potential for Dark Side could be huge.

Combos:

= Greeve can react to a battle, can fire repeatedly at +1 to hit, makes the target forfeit -3, and adds a battle destiny with Used interrupts!

= Try and use the Hidden Trail to get Greeve next to a potential battle location, especially useful if you can set up a no Dark Side force icons location there (so they don't deploy to battle Greeve instead!). Try using a [[Nudj]]!
|combos=* Greeve + [[A280 Sharpshooter Rifle]] + [[Slight Weapons Malfunction]] Greeve can react to a battle, can fire repeatedly at +1 to hit, makes the target forfeit -3, and adds a battle destiny with Used interrupts!<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Lieutenant%20Greeve</ref>
* Greeve + [[A280 Sharpshooter Rifle]] + [[Endor: Hidden Forest Trail]] Try and use the Hidden Trail to get Greeve next to a potential battle location, especially useful if you can set up a no Dark Side force icons location there (so they don't deploy to battle Greeve instead!). Try using a [[Nudj]]!
